description:
The individual trades a backtest made -- entry and exit prices and times, profit or loss, and why each one closed. Use it when the user asks what a backtest actually traded; get_backtest has the summary metrics. THESE ARE SIMULATED TRADES from a backtest, not real ones -- list_trades has those. A long run is paged: pass offset to read on.

[Access: pay 0.001 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]

backtest_id.description: The run's UUID, as run_backtest returned it.

offset.description: Pagination offset in the result units documented by the tool; zero starts the first page.

name: get_backtest_trades
